fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (missing-acceptance on land-conflict-to-fixer): The acceptance names its testscript only as a placeholder: 'go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/<the ship land conflict script>'. A builder or verifier cannot run that command as written. Name the script (for example ship-land-conflict) so the check is concrete. Also note that ship-change.toml's land step has no on.fail today, so the acceptance should say which step the conflict routes to (conflict-fix, or conflict-fix-landed). The critic confirmed it: The acceptance of land-conflict-to-fixer (in change set 01M76XSQKQJ8P78585NDYPATM7) names its testscript as 'TestScripts/<the ship land conflict script>', a placeholder no builder or verifier can run. The script needs a concrete name (e.g. run-ship-land-conflict, beside the existing run-ship-conflict-fix.txtar). The routing part is already stated: the acceptance says the run reaches the conflict-fix step, which exists in internal/workflow/builtin/ship-change.toml. How should it be settled?
